headline: RI Government Seeks Rp 30 Trillion, Auctions 9 Government Bonds Today
summary: The government will auction nine rupiah-denominated government bond (SUN) series on Tuesday, seeking to raise about Rp30 trillion. The auction is part of its financing program.
why: Government bond auctions set borrowing costs and the yield curve that anchors Indonesian financial markets.
original_headline: Pemerintah RI Cari Dana Rp 30 Triliun, Lelang 9 Surat Utang Hari Ini
